synopsis: An observational comedy about an older man curious about the beauty products of a seemingly perfect girl(?!). Kameyama, an ordinary salaryman, can't help but wonder what that pretty girl at the train station is wearing. That Milbon scent is lovely! Her glowing skin... must be some kind of treatment! Which brand's cosmetics is that? All of those "cute things" he used to obsess about, now appearing before him in person! (Source: Flex Comix, translated)

synopsis: A college student, Sakurai Hiroki was summoned to another world to defeat the Demon Lord. And since he got “Priest” as a job, his starting Recovery Stat was more than enough to heal any wounds, so he dumped all of his Stat Points into Evasion. In other words, he’s aiming for an Evasion Healer who will never get hit by enemy attacks. But unfortunately, people in that world couldn’t understand his ideal! The King got angry at him and almost immediately labeled him as useless! And thus, the story of how Hiroki become an odd Healer who can even avoid Dungeon Boss’ attacks with ease has started!!

synopsis: The editor-in-chief, Maki Ishikawa, is kind to co-workers, good at her job, and acts like the ideal boss! But in front of her junior colleague, Nodoka Minami, she starts acting strangely. "Maki-senpai, I can always count on you!" Minami says with a big smile. Maki wants to get to know Minami better, but she is worried, "Would it be harassment to ask for her phone number?" “Is it be too much if I ask her out to lunch?" she wonders… Aah!!! She definitely doesn't want come across like a creep, but she wishes they could be be friends! (Source: forcs, translated)
